data.rationale: Section 2 references a Schedule of Activities, which typically outlines data collection at each study visit on a recurring basis
Section 6.1 inclusion criteria are assessed once at screening to determine patient eligibility
Section 6.2 exclusion criteria are evaluated once at screening as a one-time eligibility determination
Section 6.4 screen failure assessment is a one-time determination made at the screening visit
Section 7.6 treatment compliance monitoring is assessed repeatedly at scheduled study visits throughout the trial
Section 7.4 dose modification involves conditional decision points based on patient response or adverse events, representing an ordered conditional workflow
Section 7.7 concomitant therapy is reviewed at each study visit on a recurring scheduled basis
Section 8 discontinuation criteria involve conditional decision points triggered by specific clinical events or thresholds, representing a conditional workflow
Section 3.3 benefit/risk assessment is conducted once as part of the protocol development and study rationale
Section 7.8.1.1 continued access involves conditional evaluation after study completion based on specific criteria being met
